Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.ResponseMeta!.Etag);
Console.WriteLine(result.ResponseMeta!.LastModified);
Console.WriteLine(result.ResponseMeta!.Server);
Console.WriteLine(result.ResponseMeta!.ContentLanguage);
```
